info.title: PixelVault API
info.description: Agent-first image, PDF document, and original-MP4 hosting API. Upload media via API and get instant CDN URLs. PDFs are always served as download attachments. Free tier: 200 MB storage, 500 uploads/month, 1 GB bandwidth/month.

bearerAuth.description: API key. Secret keys (pv_live_ / pv_test_) grant full access. Publishable keys (pv_pub_) are safe to embed in browser code: upload-only (POST /v1/images) and restricted to an allowlist of request Origins configured per key. Example: Bearer pv_live_xxxxxxxx

sessionAuth.description: Dashboard session token, issued by POST /v1/auth/login. Used by endpoints a signed-in person drives from the web app, including media uploads and management.

DashboardDescription.description: Compact AI-description state for the dashboard: `pending` while the vision call runs (a few seconds), `done` with the alt text, or `failed`. Null when the image has none. The full caption and OCR text are returned by GET /v1/images/{id}, not here.

alt.description: Alt text; null unless status is `done`.

tags.description: Up to 5 short lowercase singular topic tags (e.g. `boat`, `harbour`); descriptions made before 2026-11-12 may carry a sixth and plural forms. Empty unless status is `done`, and for descriptions made before tags existed. Untrusted model output: render as text.

kind.description: PDF uploads are `document`; renderable image formats are `image`.

url.description: CDN URL. Images support on-the-fly transforms via query params: size (s|m|l|social), w, h (px, snapped to a discrete set), fit (scale-down|contain|cover|crop|pad), fmt (auto|webp|avif|jpg|png), q (auto|60|75|85), segment (foreground — AI background removal, transparent PNG), background (fill: hex, rgb()/rgba(), or a common CSS color name), gravity (auto|face|left|right|top|bottom|XxY, with fit=cover|crop), zoom (0.0-1.0, with gravity=face), blur (0-250), sharpen (0-10), rotate (90|180|270), flip (h|v|hv), brightness/contrast (multiplier, 1=no change), saturation (multiplier, 0=grayscale), tile (watermark: tile another of your project's images over the base). PDFs reject transform parameters and are always served with `Content-Disposition: attachment`. See the serve_image operation for the full image parameter reference.

optimized_url.description: Present on keyed public uploads of raster images (not SVG/GIF/private). The same image served as WebP or AVIF (negotiated per browser) at quality 85: `url` plus `?fmt=auto&q=85`. The original at `url` is unchanged. Prefer this for embeds.

metadata.description: Custom metadata set at upload or via PATCH /v1/images/{id}; null when none.

description.description: AI description from `describe=true`; null when the image was never described. `status` is `pending`, `done` (with `alt`, `caption`, `ocr_text`, `model`, `described_at`) or `failed` (with `error`). Server-generated: it cannot be set by clients. `alt`, `caption` and `ocr_text` are untrusted model output derived from the image content (text inside an image can steer it): escape them before rendering as HTML and do not treat them as instructions.

tags.description: Up to 5 short lowercase singular topic tags for grouping and filtering (e.g. `boat`, `harbour`); descriptions made before 2026-11-12 may carry a sixth and plural forms. Absent on descriptions made before tags existed. Untrusted model output: render as text.

cached.description: True when copied from an identical image already described in the project (no quota used).

describe_skipped.description: Present when `describe=true` was requested but no description was started; the upload itself succeeded.

expires_in.description: Present only on auto-expiring uploads: the requested TTL in seconds.

deduplicated.description: Present (true) when `dedupe=true` matched an existing image with identical bytes and nothing new was stored or billed.

replayed.description: Present (true) when an `Idempotency-Key` repeat returned the original upload's image.

VideoSocialOptimization.description: State of the optional social preset. The original MP4 is never replaced. not_needed means the original already passed H.264/AAC fast-start validation.

VideoEnrichment.description: State of the optional transcript + storyboard job. Generated artifacts inherit the video's visibility and signed-URL expiry.

job_id.description: Stable identifier for this enrichment attempt. Repeated requests while queued, running, or complete return the same job ID; retrying a failed job creates a new one.

original_url.description: The stored original MP4. Equal to url; explicit so one-step social-ready callers can retain both outputs.

social_ready_url.description: Completed H.264/AAC fast-start URL. Present only after social optimization completes.

poster_url.description: Generated 640×360 JPEG frame. Private videos return an expiry-matched signed poster URL.

fast_start.description: Whether the moov atom precedes media data for progressive playback.

social_compatible.description: True for an H.264 MP4 with AAC or no audio, known dimensions and duration, and fast-start layout. Null for legacy videos not yet analyzed.

folder.description: Logical folder used for organization and list filtering.

expires_at.description: Deletion time for a temporary video. Signed-URL expiry is separate.

temporary.description: Present and true only when expires_at is set.

replayed.description: Present and true when an idempotent retry returns an existing video.

signed_expires.description: Unix timestamp when private original and derivative bearer URLs expire.

VideoSignedUrls.description: Expiry-matched bearer URLs for the original and every completed derivative. Optional URLs are omitted until their artifact exists.

expires.description: Unix timestamp shared by every URL in this response.

original_url.description: The original uploaded bytes; PixelVault does not transcode audio.

expires_at.description: Deletion time for a temporary audio asset. Signed-URL expiry is separate.

replayed.description: Present and true when an idempotent retry returns the committed asset.

signed_expires.description: Unix timestamp when the private bearer URL expires.

expires.description: Unix timestamp when the bearer URL expires.

VideoEnrichmentWebhookEvent.description: Signed terminal enrichment event. The event id is stable across delivery retries; job_id identifies one enrichment attempt and changes when a failed job is retried.

id.description: Stable event id. Deduplicate repeated deliveries on this value.

signed_expires.description: Unix expiry for private original/poster URLs. Omitted for public video.

job_id.description: Stable identifier for this enrichment attempt.

status_url.description: GET this video to poll or inspect current state.

refresh_url.description: POST with expires_in to mint fresh private original and artifact URLs.

signed_expires.description: Unix expiry shared by private artifact URLs. Omitted for public video.

artifacts.description: Only artifacts that exist. Present only for completed enrichment.

error.description: Safe code and message. Present only for failed enrichment.

post.summary: Create account and get API key
post.description: Creates an account with a default project and returns a live API key instantly. No browser or signup form needed. The password is optional: omit it for a passwordless (agent) account — the owner can set a password later via the reset flow to enable dashboard login.

password.description: Optional. Omit for a passwordless account; provide (min 8 chars) to enable password login immediately.

password_set.description: Whether the account has an owner-chosen password. False for passwordless accounts until a password is set via the reset flow.

post.summary: Start email-code sign-in
post.description: Step 1 of a passwordless sign-in that needs no browser. Emails a 6-digit code (valid 10 minutes) to the address; creates the account first if the email is new, exactly like `register_account`. Finish with `device_login_complete`. At most one code per 60 seconds per account; disposable email domains are rejected. Needs a human (or a mailbox the caller controls) to read the code.

429.description: A code was already sent in the last 60 seconds, or the per-IP auth limit (5/min) was hit

post.summary: Exchange the emailed code for an API key
post.description: Step 2 of the email-code sign-in. Validates the code (3 attempts, single use), marks the email verified, and returns a NEW secret API key for the account's default project. Each call mints an additional key (list and revoke them with `list_keys` / `revoke_key`), unless `replace_existing` is true, which deletes older live secret keys that share the same `label`.

label.description: Name for the new key (default "PixelVault Desktop"). Shown in the dashboard and in `list_keys`.

replace_existing.description: Delete older live secret keys with the same label after minting this one, so reconnecting does not pile up keys.

200.description: Signed in. The key is shown only once.

400.description: Missing fields, `invalid_code`, `code_expired` or `too_many_attempts` (request a new code)

404.description: No account for this email; call `device_login_start` first

post.summary: Upload an image or PDF
post.description: Upload a file and receive a public CDN URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, SVG, PDF). PDFs are opaque, download-only documents: they are served with `Content-Disposition: attachment`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`, and reject image transforms. Works WITHOUT an API key: keyless uploads are temporary (response includes `temporary: true` and `expires_in`, ~30 days) — add a Bearer key to make uploads permanent. Send multipart/form-data (a file), or, with a key, application/json `{ url }` to import from an https URL. Retry-safe: send an `Idempotency-Key` header and a retry after a timeout returns the original upload instead of storing a second copy; add `dedupe=true` to reuse an existing upload with identical bytes. `width` and `height` are returned only for image formats whose header carries them.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Keyed uploads. A repeat with the same key and the same bytes returns the original image (200, `replayed: true`); the same key with different bytes, a different visibility, or an expired image returns 422 `idempotency_key_reuse`. A replay describes the stored image, not the retry. Keys are scoped to the project and live as long as the image. Cannot be combined with `dedupe`.

file.description: Image or PDF file to upload

visibility.description: 'private' (secret key only) stores the image behind a signed URL and the response `url` is signed; default 'public'.

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime in seconds for a private upload (60–2592000, default 3600).

expires_in.description: Optional auto-expiry in seconds (60–2592000). The image is deleted by an hourly sweep after this time, so removal can lag the TTL by up to about two hours; the response echoes `expires_in` and `temporary: true`. Omit for a permanent image (keyed uploads).

metadata.description: Optional custom metadata (JSON object, max 50 top-level keys / 4 KB serialized) stored with the image and filterable via `GET /v1/images?metadata=...` or `meta[key]=value`. Multipart: send it as a JSON string. Keyed uploads only (ignored on keyless uploads), and ignored when `dedupe` or an `Idempotency-Key` replay returns an existing image: use `PATCH /v1/images/{id}` to change it. NUL characters and unpaired surrogates are rejected. Client-supplied; do not store secrets.

describe.description: Keyed uploads. When true, an AI description (alt text, caption, OCR text) is generated for the new image in the background and stored as `description`; poll GET /v1/images/{id} until `description.status` is `done`. Plan-gated: free 20 in total, Starter 1,000 a month, Pro 10,000 a month. Needs a secret key and a verified email. Over quota, unsupported type (JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF up to 4 MB only) or a busy service never fail the upload: the response carries `describe_skipped` instead. Identical bytes already described in the project are reused at no charge. Ignored when dedupe or an Idempotency-Key replay returns an existing image. Default false.

dedupe.description: Keyed uploads. When true and the project already has an image with identical bytes, the same visibility, folder and a lifetime at least as long as requested, that image is returned (200, `deduplicated: true`) and no upload is stored or counted. Best-effort: simultaneous uploads of the same bytes can each be stored. Cannot be combined with `Idempotency-Key`. Default false.

url.description: Source image or PDF URL to import (https only). Requires an API key.

visibility.description: 'private' stores the image behind a signed URL and the response `url` is signed; default 'public'.

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime in seconds for a private upload (60–2592000, default 3600).

expires_in.description: Optional auto-expiry in seconds (60–2592000). The image is deleted by an hourly sweep after this time, so removal can lag the TTL by up to about two hours; the response echoes `expires_in` and `temporary: true`. Omit for a permanent image.

metadata.description: Optional custom metadata (JSON object, max 50 top-level keys / 4 KB serialized) stored with the image and filterable via `GET /v1/images?metadata=...` or `meta[key]=value`. Multipart: send it as a JSON string. Keyed uploads only (ignored on keyless uploads), and ignored when `dedupe` or an `Idempotency-Key` replay returns an existing image: use `PATCH /v1/images/{id}` to change it. NUL characters and unpaired surrogates are rejected. Client-supplied; do not store secrets.

describe.description: Keyed uploads. When true, an AI description (alt text, caption, OCR text) is generated for the new image in the background and stored as `description`; poll GET /v1/images/{id} until `description.status` is `done`. Plan-gated: free 20 in total, Starter 1,000 a month, Pro 10,000 a month. Needs a secret key and a verified email. Over quota, unsupported type (JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF up to 4 MB only) or a busy service never fail the upload: the response carries `describe_skipped` instead. Identical bytes already described in the project are reused at no charge. Ignored when dedupe or an Idempotency-Key replay returns an existing image. Default false.

dedupe.description: When true and the project already has an image with identical bytes, the same visibility, folder and a lifetime at least as long as requested, that image is returned (200, `deduplicated: true`) and nothing is stored or counted. Default false.

200.description: Nothing new was stored: an `Idempotency-Key` replay or a `dedupe` match. The image carries `replayed` or `deduplicated`.

422.description: `idempotency_key_reuse`: the Idempotency-Key was already used with different image content.

get.description: Get a paginated list of images in the project.

parameters.name: collection_id
parameters.description: Only images in this collection.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search over the AI description (alt text, caption, OCR text) of images uploaded with `describe=true`, best match first (words are ANDed; quote phrases, `-word` excludes). Max 200 characters. Combines (AND) with `metadata` and `collection_id`. Images that were never described are not matched.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only images carrying this AI tag (one tag, e.g. `boat`; see GET /v1/images/tags for the tags in use). Matched in the lowercase form tags are stored in. Combines (AND) with `q`, `metadata` and `collection_id`. Images that were never described have no tags.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: JSON object; returns images whose custom metadata contains every key/value pair (e.g. `{"env":"prod"}`). Typed values match exactly; nested objects match by containment. Conflicting duplicates (the same key with different values across `metadata` and `meta[key]`) return 400.

parameters.name: meta[key]
parameters.description: Shorthand string match on one metadata key, e.g. `?meta[env]=prod`. Use it once per key, for several different keys; combines (AND) with `metadata`.

get.summary: List the project's AI tags with counts
get.description: The AI tags on the project's described images with how many images carry each, most used first (at most 40). Filter the image list with GET /v1/images?tag=.

post.summary: Start an AI description for an existing image
post.description: Start the AI description (alt text, caption, OCR text, tags) of a stored image, for images uploaded without `describe=true`. Needs a secret key. Idempotent: an image that is already described, or being described, returns its current state and uses none of the allowance. A failed or stalled description is started again (and uses one unit). A description takes a few seconds: poll GET /v1/images/{id} until `description.status` is `done` (do not poll this endpoint). Uses the account's description allowance (free: 20 for life; Starter: 1,000 a month; Pro: 10,000 a month); when it is used up, `describe_skipped` is `quota`. An unknown id or another project's image returns 404.

200.description: The image's description state, or why none was started

403.description: A publishable key, or a suspended account

get.description: Retrieve metadata and CDN URL for a specific image.

patch.description: Replace an image's custom metadata. The object you send replaces the stored one (it is not merged); send `null` or `{}` to clear it. Max 50 top-level keys / 4 KB serialized.

delete.description: Permanently delete an image from storage and CDN.

post.summary: Generate an image from a text prompt
post.description: Create an image from a text prompt with a Cloudflare Workers AI model and host it in one call. Returns the same payload as an upload (permanent CDN URL, dimensions, optimized_url) plus a `generation` block. Costs credits from your monthly grant (free 10, Starter 300, Pro 1500; credits reset on the 1st, UTC): FLUX schnell and SDXL cost 1, Leonardo models cost 20. The free plan can use flux-1-schnell only. Credits are refunded if generation or storage fails. The image also counts toward your upload and storage quotas. Requires a secret key and a verified email. Requests refused for plan, quota, credit or validation reasons never run the model. Prompts that clearly ask for adult content are refused (see the Terms of Service).

prompt.example: A minimalist hero image of a mountain at sunrise, flat illustration

model.description: Model id. Credits per image: flux-1-schnell 1, sdxl-lightning 1, sdxl-base 1, lucid-origin 20, phoenix-1.0 20. The SDXL models are in beta.

folder.description: Optional folder (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores; max 64 chars).

expires_in.description: Delete the image after this many seconds (60–2592000).

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime for private URLs in seconds (60–2592000).

optimized_url.description: Same image as WebP/AVIF; prefer it for embedding.

402.description: Out of generation credits (generation_credits_exhausted), the model needs a paid plan (model_requires_paid_plan), or an upload/storage quota was reached

403.description: Publishable keys can't generate images (generation_forbidden), or the account's email isn't verified (email_verification_required)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: 60 generations per hour per account, or the day's overall generation capacity is used up. Carries Retry-After. Credits are refunded.

502.description: The model failed or returned no usable image (generation_failed). Credits are refunded.

503.description: Image generation is temporarily unavailable (generation_unavailable). Credits are refunded.

504.description: The model timed out (generation_timeout). Credits are refunded; safe to retry.

post.summary: Edit an image with a natural-language instruction
post.description: Create a new hosted image by editing an existing image you own; the source is never overwritten. Uses Cloudflare FLUX.2 with zero data retention. Fast edits cost 1 monthly edit credit and work on every plan (Free 5, Starter 100, Pro 500); quality edits cost 5 and require a paid plan. Credits reset on the 1st (UTC) and are refunded if model inference or storage fails. JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF sources up to 20 MB are accepted. Output visibility defaults to the source visibility. The new image also counts toward upload and storage quotas. Accepts either a secret API key or the signed-in dashboard session; the account must have a verified email.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Source image id.

prompt.example: Remove the people in the background.

model.description: Fast costs 1 edit credit. Quality costs 5 and requires a paid plan.

folder.description: Folder for the new image. Defaults to the source folder.

visibility.description: Visibility for the new image. Defaults to the source visibility.

expires_in.description: Delete the new image after this many seconds. Omit for permanent.

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime for a private result URL.

401.description: Invalid or missing API key or dashboard session

402.description: Edit credits exhausted, quality model requires a paid plan, or upload/storage quota reached

429.description: Editing rate or daily cost limit exceeded; carries Retry-After

502.description: Source preparation or model output failed; edit credits refunded

503.description: Image editing unavailable; edit credits refunded

504.description: Image editing timed out; edit credits refunded

post.summary: Batch upload into a collection
post.description: Upload many images in one request, grouped into a collection (e.g. a CI run). Partial-failure tolerant: each item reports ok true/false independently. Private collections return signed URLs. The collection is upserted by (type, name), so re-running the same job is idempotent.

name.description: Idempotency key within (project, type) — e.g. the CI run id.

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime for private URLs in seconds (60–2592000). Defaults to 7 days.

metadata.description: Freeform collection metadata (e.g. commit, pr_number, branch).

source_url.description: Public URL to import instead of data.

402.description: Free-plan private-image limit reached (upgrade for unlimited private images)

get.description: Plan, limits and current usage for the calling key's project, so an agent can check quota before work. Storage is cumulative; uploads and credit/second allowances use the current UTC month. `bandwidth` always carries the real limit, units and accounting period, but currently reports `status: unavailable` with null used/remaining values because the CDN's approximate counters are not exposed reliably to this worker. A usage check neither reserves capacity nor guarantees that a future CDN request will serve. Unique-transform usage is also unavailable. Requires a secret key.

bandwidth.description: Monthly CDN bandwidth measurement. Null is unknown, never zero. The current backend returns unavailable because its approximate CDN counter is not reliably readable here. `available` permits numeric zero; `unlimited` uses null limit/remaining; `delayed` freshness means measured_at predates the request.

used.description: Bytes accounted in this period, or null when unknown/not applicable.

remaining.description: Bytes left, or null when unknown/unlimited.

limit.description: Monthly byte limit, or null only when status is unlimited.

measured_at.description: When used was measured; null when unavailable.

generation.description: AI image-generation credits (POST /v1/images/generate) for the current month.

credits_limit.description: Monthly generation credit grant for the plan.

credits_remaining.description: Generation credits left this month (floored at 0).

editing.description: Natural-language image-edit credits (POST /v1/images/{id}/edit) for the current month.

credits_limit.description: Monthly edit credit grant for the plan.

credits_remaining.description: Edit credits left this month (floored at 0).

video_optimization.description: Social-ready video source seconds reserved in the current month.

video_enrichment.description: Transcript + storyboard source seconds reserved in the current month.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

get.description: Every key on the calling key's project. Hashes and raw keys are never returned; `current` marks the key that made this request. Requires a secret key.

current.description: True for the key that authenticated this request.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

post.summary: Create an API key
post.description: Mint an additional secret key for the project. The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved again. A project can hold at most 25 keys (409 `key_limit_reached`), and creating or revoking keys is limited to 20 changes per hour per project. To rotate: create a new key, switch to it, then revoke the old one with `DELETE /v1/keys/{id}`. Requires a secret key.

api_key.description: The raw key. Shown only in this response.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

delete.description: Permanently revoke a secret key on the project (publishable keys are managed from the dashboard and return 404). The key authenticating the request cannot revoke itself (409 `cannot_revoke_current_key`). The delete only applies while the calling key still exists, so two keys revoking each other concurrently cannot leave the project without a key; the loser gets 409 `conflict`. Limited to 20 key changes per hour per project. Requires a secret key.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

404.description: Secret key not found on this project

409.description: `cannot_revoke_current_key` (the key making the request), or `conflict` (already revoked, or the calling key was revoked concurrently)

get.description: List the current project's signed webhook endpoints and plan limit. Requires a secret API key or dashboard session.

post.summary: Create a webhook endpoint
post.description: Create a public-HTTPS endpoint for consumer-actionable media lifecycle events: create/delete, AI description completion/failure, export completion/failure, video optimization completion/failure, and video enrichment completion/failure. Synchronous generation and editing failures stay in their API responses; their successful outputs emit `media.created` with `source` `generation` or `edit`. Returns `signing_secret` once. Starter supports 3 endpoints; Pro supports 10; Free receives 402. Delivery is at least once: deduplicate on the stable event `id`; repeated delivery attempts retain that id, while a retried enrichment job has a new `job_id`. PixelVault retries non-2xx/network failures after approximately 1m, 5m, 30m, and 2h. Polling `GET /v1/videos/{id}` remains supported. Private artifact URLs in callbacks expire; call the payload's `refresh_url` to mint a fresh set.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL on port 443. Redirects are not followed.

post.summary: Signed terminal video enrichment event

201.description: Endpoint created; signing_secret is shown only in this response.

409.description: Endpoint limit reached or URL already configured

delete.summary: Delete a webhook endpoint and its delivery log

post.summary: Rotate a webhook signing secret
post.description: Immediately invalidates the previous signing secret and returns the replacement once.

get.description: Newest-first delivery attempts retained for 30 days. Response bodies are never stored.

post.summary: Mint a signed (private) URL
post.description: Return a time-limited signed URL for a private image. The signature binds the image (and project), so the URL can't be replayed against another image. Generates the project's signing secret on first use. Use a long expires_in (e.g. for a PR's lifetime) and re-sign on updates to avoid link rot.

expires_in.description: Signature lifetime in seconds (60–2592000). Defaults to 3600 (1 hour).

expires.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the URL expires.

post.summary: Start a paid-plan checkout
post.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the chosen plan. A human completes payment on that page; the plan changes only after Stripe confirms. Live secret API key (pv_live_) or dashboard token; test and publishable keys get 403. Requires a verified email. Limited to 10 requests per hour per account.

200.description: { url } to open in a browser

400.description: `invalid_plan`: plan must be starter or pro

401.description: Invalid or missing key or token

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 per hour per account)

post.summary: Open the billing portal
post.description: Returns a Stripe customer-portal URL to change plan, update payment details or cancel. Live secret API key (pv_live_) or dashboard token; test and publishable keys get 403. Limited to 10 requests per hour per account.

200.description: { url } to open in a browser

401.description: Invalid or missing key or token

404.description: `no_subscription`: no billing history for this account

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 per hour per account)

get.description: List the project's collections, optionally filtered by type and/or name (name is the CI run id, generation id, etc.).

get.summary: Get a collection and its media
get.description: Returns assets for every member, plus the backward-compatible images subset. Private asset URLs are unsigned identifiers; use the media type's sign-url endpoint.

200.description: The collection with assets and its legacy images subset

post.summary: Close a collection
post.description: Marks a collection closed and makes all member media eligible for lifecycle cleanup ahead of their TTL.

post.summary: Start a media export
post.description: Starts an asynchronous tar export of every non-expired image and video in the project. manifest.json keeps the v1 images array and adds video originals, custom metadata, collection/folder membership, job state, and parent relationships for existing posters, optimized copies, transcripts, and storyboards. Private bytes are included under owner-authenticated download, but the manifest never stores permanent or stale signed URLs. Pending and failed jobs are recorded without invented artifact paths. Deleted assets are absent at snapshot time; an asset deleted during assembly remains in the manifest but its missing bytes are skipped. Poll status_url until complete.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Required only when authenticating with a dashboard token; ignored for secret-key auth (the key already identifies the project).

202.description: Export job accepted. Poll status_url until status is 'complete'.

404.description: Project not found for this account

409.description: An export for this project is already in progress

get.description: Poll an export job. processed_count counts asset rows, not derived files. When status is complete, the response includes download_url. Auth is the same as starting an export.
Stream the completed export as a tar archive (application/x-tar) containing manifest.json plus every image. 409 if the job isn't complete yet; 410 if it has expired.

post.summary: Claim anonymous media into your account
post.description: Exchange the `claim_token` from POST /v1/playground/upload or POST /v1/playground/video for permanent media in your account. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key. Idempotent per project: re-claiming returns the media already saved. Valid for 24 hours, after which the temporary upload no longer exists.

token.description: The `claim_token` returned by an anonymous playground upload.

200.description: Already claimed — the same media, returned without storing a second copy

402.description: Storage limit reached — a plan ceiling, not a rate limit

403.description: Unverified account at the pre-verification upload cap

404.description: The account has no project to save into

410.description: The temporary upload has expired and is gone

429.description: Rate limit or monthly upload quota exceeded

post.summary: Upload or securely import original audio
post.description: Hosts original MP3, WAV, M4A, or OGG bytes without transcoding, up to the approved global 25,000,000-byte original-file ceiling. This ceiling is not a reserved capacity or plan allowance. PixelVault validates the actual container and accepts MPEG Layer III, PCM/IEEE-float WAV, AAC-in-M4A, and Opus/Vorbis-in-Ogg combinations. Direct uploads require Content-Length and use X-PixelVault-Filename, X-PixelVault-Visibility, X-PixelVault-Expires-In, X-PixelVault-Folder, X-PixelVault-Collection-Id, and X-PixelVault-Metadata headers. URL imports use the equivalent JSON fields and the existing SSRF-safe importer. Idempotency-Key is project- and audio-endpoint-scoped for 24 hours; direct retries also require X-PixelVault-Content-SHA256. A misconfigured deployment returns 503 audio_policy_pending rather than accepting an unbounded upload.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Content-SHA256
parameters.description: Required with Idempotency-Key for a direct byte upload.

409.description: Idempotency key conflict or upload still in progress

413.description: Configured original-file or Worker request limit exceeded

503.description: Audio creation is gated until its maximum file-size policy is configured

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: JSON containment filter; repeated metadata.key=value query parameters are also supported.

post.summary: Mint a fresh audio bearer URL
Upload or import an original MP4
post.description: Hosts original MP4 bytes or securely imports an https URL. Idempotency-Key is scoped to the authenticated project and retained for 24 hours: same inputs replay the original asset (200), conflicting inputs return 422, and an active retry returns 409 without creating another upload. Direct uploads using a key must send X-PixelVault-Content-SHA256; URL imports fingerprint the URL and storage settings. Idempotency is not content deduplication: different keys create distinct assets, never across projects or visibility. expires_in deletes the original, poster, optimized copy, transcript, and storyboard; active jobs are failed and released first. Signed-URL expiry does not delete the asset. The original is always preserved. Raw requests need Content-Length and multipart above 100 MB; URL imports require remote Content-Length.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Filename
parameters.description: Original filename for a raw video/mp4 request. Percent-encode non-ASCII characters.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Visibility
parameters.description: Raw video visibility. Private uploads require a secret key.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Sign-Expires-In
parameters.description: Lifetime of returned private video and poster URLs in seconds.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Social-Ready
parameters.description: For a raw video/mp4 upload, enqueue a separate H.264/AAC fast-start copy while preserving the original.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Non-space printable ASCII key, maximum 255 characters. Replays for 24 hours within this project.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Content-SHA256
parameters.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of raw MP4 bytes. Required with Idempotency-Key for direct uploads and verified while streaming.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Metadata
parameters.description: JSON object string containing custom metadata.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Expires-In
parameters.description: Asset deletion TTL in seconds.

url.description: Public https URL for the MP4.

filename.description: Optional original filename; defaults to the URL path.

social_ready.description: Enqueue a separate social-ready copy while preserving the original.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an existing video

400.description: Invalid MP4, URL, or remote response

409.description: A matching idempotent upload is still active

413.description: Plan limit exceeded or raw upload needs multipart

422.description: Idempotency-Key reused with conflicting inputs or collection visibility mismatch

parameters.name: collection_id
parameters.description: Only videos in this collection.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Exact logical-folder match.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: JSON object containment filter. meta[key]=value query parameters are also supported.

patch.description: Updates custom metadata, logical folder, and/or existing collection membership. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null clears. Collection visibility must match the video.

post.summary: Create a social-ready H.264/AAC fast-start MP4
post.description: Idempotently enqueues the social preset while preserving the original. Returns 202 while pending/processing and 200 when complete or when the original is already compatible. Supports source MP4s up to 100 MB and 60 seconds. Monthly output allowances: Free 2 minutes, Starter 30 minutes, Pro 120 minutes. Poll GET /v1/videos/{id} until social_optimization.status is complete or failed.

200.description: Already complete or original already social-ready

422.description: Duration or MP4 metadata is unsupported

post.summary: Generate a transcript and storyboard
post.description: Idempotently enqueues transcript text, timed WebVTT, timestamped JSON segments, and bounded storyboard sheets. Returns 202 while pending/processing and 200 when complete. Silent videos skip the transcript but still receive a storyboard. Supports source MP4s from 1 second through 10 minutes and up to 100 MB. Monthly source-minute allowances: Free 2 minutes, Starter 30 minutes, Pro 120 minutes. Poll GET /v1/videos/{id} until enrichment.status is complete or failed.

422.description: Duration or MP4 metadata is unsupported

post.summary: Analyze video metadata and social compatibility
post.description: Reads bounded MP4 container metadata without transcoding. Use this to backfill legacy videos or refresh compatibility fields.

post.summary: Generate or return a video's poster frame
post.description: Idempotently extracts and stores a 640×360 JPEG frame. Use this to backfill legacy videos or retry a transient transformation failure.

post.summary: Create signed URLs for a video and its derivatives
post.description: Returns expiry-matched bearer URLs for the original MP4, poster, completed social-ready copy, transcript artifacts, and storyboard sheets when present.

200.description: Expiry-matched signed URLs for every available artifact

post.summary: Create a multipart MP4 upload
post.description: Starts a 24-hour multipart session. Idempotency-Key is project-scoped and replays the same active or completed session for 24 hours; conflicting inputs return 422. sha256 is required with a key. This retry contract is separate from content deduplication. Use the returned 10 MiB part_size for equal non-final parts, upload parts sequentially, then complete.

sha256.description: Whole-file digest used to detect conflicting retries. Required with Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an active or completed session

put.description: Parts are sequential from 1. Every non-final part must use the session's part_size. For idempotent sessions, send X-PixelVault-Part-SHA256; exact part retries return the stored part with replayed=true, while conflicting bytes return 409.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Part-SHA256
parameters.description: Hex SHA-256 verified while streaming; required when the session has an Idempotency-Key.

409.description: Part already exists with conflicting or unverifiable bytes

post.summary: Complete and validate an MP4 upload

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Social-Ready
parameters.description: Enqueue a social-ready copy after multipart completion. Sources must be at most 100 MB and 60 seconds.

200.description: Idempotent replay after a successful commit

204.description: Upload aborted and reserved quota released

409.description: The upload already committed; delete the video asset instead

get.summary: List and search images from a signed-in session
get.description: The signed-in account's images across all its projects, newest first. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key — this is what the web dashboard's image list calls to load more and to search. Callers with an API key should use GET /v1/images. `q` is a case-insensitive substring match on the original filename (wildcards are matched literally) OR a full-text match in the image's AI description (alt text, caption, OCR text).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filename search text (max 100 characters).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only images carrying this AI tag (one tag: letters, digits, spaces or hyphens, lowercased). Combines with `q`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated image ids (at most 20): return only these of the caller's own images. Read-only; the dashboard uses it to watch a pending AI description finish.

url.description: CDN URL; a short-lived signed URL for private images.

post.summary: Upload an image or PDF from a signed-in session
post.description:
Store one image or PDF document for the signed-in account. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key — this is what the web dashboard and converter tools call, so a person who has never been issued a key can still add media. PDFs are served as forced downloads. The upload lands in the account's default project.

Deliberately narrow: one file per request, no folder, visibility, TTL or URL import. Callers that need those should use POST /v1/images with an API key.

file.description: The image or PDF file. Max 5 MB on Free, 10 MB on Starter, 15 MB on Pro; type is detected from magic bytes.

describe.description: Set to `true` to also start an AI description (alt text, caption, OCR text) for this image. Uses the account's description allowance (free: 20 for life; Starter: 1,000 a month; Pro: 10,000 a month). Never fails the upload: the response says why nothing was started.

describe_skipped.description: Present only when describe was requested and no description was started.

400.description: No file provided, or the bytes are not a supported image

402.description: Storage limit reached — a plan ceiling, not a rate limit

403.description: Unverified account at the pre-verification upload cap

404.description: The account has no project to upload into

413.description: File larger than the plan's per-image cap (5 MB free and keyless, 10 MB Starter, 15 MB Pro)

429.description: Rate limit or monthly upload quota exceeded

get.summary: List the account's AI tags with counts (signed-in session)
get.description: The AI tags on the signed-in account's described images with how many images carry each, most used first (at most 40). Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key. The dashboard uses it for its tag filter bar; filter the list with GET /v1/uploads?tag=.

post.summary: Start an AI description for an existing image (signed-in session)
post.description: Start the AI description (alt text, caption, OCR text) of one of the signed-in account's stored images — the dashboard's Describe button. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key. Idempotent: an image that is already described, or being described, returns its current state and uses none of the allowance. A failed or stalled description is started again (and uses one unit), so do not poll with this: to watch a pending description use the read-only GET /v1/uploads?ids=. A description takes a few seconds. Uses the account's description allowance (free: 20 for life; Starter: 1,000 a month; Pro: 10,000 a month); when it is used up, `describe_skipped` is `quota`. An unknown id or another account's image returns 404.

200.description: The image's description state, or why none was started

404.description: No such image in this account

delete.summary: Delete an image from a signed-in session
delete.description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in account's images (the R2 object and its record) and free its storage. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key — this is what the web dashboard's Delete button calls. Callers with an API key should use DELETE /v1/images/{id}. An id that does not exist or belongs to another account returns 404.

404.description: No such image in this account

post.summary: Anonymous image generation (browser tool)
post.description: Powers the free tool at pixelvault.dev/tools/ai-image-generator: generate one image from a prompt with FLUX.1 schnell, no account or API key, and get a temporary public CDN URL (removed within 24 hours; keep it permanently by signing up and redeeming `claim_token` at POST /v1/claim). Requires a Cloudflare Turnstile token, so it is meant for browsers; agents and scripts should use POST /v1/images/generate with an API key. Limited to 3 images per IP per day and a small global daily cap.

prompt.example: a watercolor fox reading a book

turnstile_token.description: Token from the Cloudflare Turnstile widget.

claim_token.description: Exchange at POST /v1/claim to keep the image permanently in a signed-in account. Valid for 24 hours.

400.description: Invalid body, or the prompt was refused (validation_error, prompt_rejected)

429.description: Daily free limit or global capacity reached (free_limit_reached, free_capacity_reached), or rate limited

post.summary: Anonymous image or PDF upload (no API key)
post.description: Upload an image or PDF without an account or API key and get a temporary public CDN URL plus a claim token. Rate limited to 10 uploads/hour per IP, max 2 MB. PDFs are always served as download attachments. Uploads are removed within 24 hours — use the authenticated upload for permanent hosting.

file.description: Image or PDF file to upload (max 2 MB)

claim_token.description: Proof that this caller performed the upload. Exchange it at POST /v1/claim to keep the image or document permanently in a signed-in account. Valid for 24 hours and idempotent per project — redeeming it again returns the media already saved rather than storing a second copy.

413.description: File exceeds the 2 MB playground limit

post.summary: Anonymous temporary MP4 upload
post.description: Upload an MP4 without an account or API key and get a temporary public CDN URL plus a claim token. Limited to 25 MB and 3 uploads/hour per IP. Videos are removed within 24 hours unless claimed into a signed-in account.

parameters.name: X-PixelVault-Filename
parameters.description: Original filename. Defaults to video.mp4.

claim_token.description: Exchange at POST /v1/claim within 24 hours to keep the video.

413.description: File exceeds the 25 MB temporary limit

get.description: Fetch an image from the CDN — optionally transformed on the fly via query params — from img.pixelvault.dev (not the API host). No API call or auth for public images. Transforms are edge-cached; invalid params are ignored (the original is returned, never an error); SVG sources are served as-is (not transformed). `filename` is `{image_id}.{ext}` and may be preceded by a folder path (e.g. `blog/img_abc123.png`). The effect params (segment, gravity, zoom, blur, sharpen, rotate, flip, brightness, contrast, saturation) apply to your project images, not the anonymous playground. Response headers: `X-PV-Transform` echoes the applied operations; `X-PV-Cache` is HIT|MISS.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID (omit on custom domains, where it is implied by the host).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: `{image_id}.{ext}`, optionally folder-prefixed (e.g. `blog/img_abc123.png`).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Named preset (wins over w/h). s=256w, m=640w, l=1280w, social=1200×630 OG card.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Target width in px, snapped up to a discrete set (16–4000).

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Target height in px, snapped up to a discrete set (16–4000).

parameters.name: fit
parameters.description: Resize mode. `scale-down` (default) never enlarges a smaller source; the others fit the exact box and may upscale.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Output format. `auto` negotiates WebP/AVIF via the Accept header. Omit to keep the source format. `format` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Output quality (discrete steps).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: AI background removal → transparent cut-out. Forces PNG unless a solid `background` or `fmt=webp`/`avif` is set. Project images only.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Fill behind a removed background (or the `fit=pad` area): hex (`%23ffaa00`), rgb()/rgba(), or a common CSS color name.

parameters.name: gravity
parameters.description: Crop gravity, with `fit=cover`/`crop`. `face` is face-aware. `XxY` = 0.0–1.0 coordinates.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Face-crop tightness, with `gravity=face`.

parameters.name: blur
parameters.description: Gaussian blur (0–250, snapped to a discrete set). 0 = off.

parameters.name: sharpen
parameters.description: Sharpen strength (0–10, snapped). 1 is a good default for downscaled images. 0 = off.

parameters.name: rotate
parameters.description: Rotate in 90° steps.

parameters.name: flip
parameters.description: Mirror horizontally, vertically, or both.

parameters.name: brightness
parameters.description: Brightness multiplier, snapped to 0.5/0.75/1.25/1.5/2. 1 = no change.

parameters.name: contrast
parameters.description: Contrast multiplier, snapped to 0.5/0.75/1.25/1.5/2. 1 = no change.

parameters.name: saturation
parameters.description: Saturation multiplier, snapped to 0/0.5/1.5/2. 0 = grayscale; 1 = no change.

parameters.name: tile
parameters.description: Watermark: the CDN path of another RASTER image (png/jpg/webp/avif) in the SAME project: its image_id.ext (e.g. img_logo.png), prefixed with its folder if it has one — not the original upload filename. Tiled edge-to-edge at its native size over the base. Bake opacity into the source PNG. Must be your own uploaded raster image — not an external URL and not SVG. A missing or unknown path is ignored (the base is served).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: HMAC signature for a signed (private) URL. When transform params are present they are bound into the signature.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) after which a signed URL is rejected.

200.description: The image, transformed if params were supplied.

403.description: Signed URL invalid or expired, or a signed transform could not be served.

410.description: Image expired or deleted (a placeholder image is returned).

429.description: Bandwidth limit exceeded on the free tier (a placeholder image is returned).
